patterns.title: Single Azure virtual machine (private by default)
patterns.purpose: A single Linux or Windows VM in a private virtual network for a self-contained lab, with no inbound internet access unless explicitly requested.
securityObservations: No public IP address is created unless the author opts in.
A network security group is attached and denies inbound traffic by default.
Administrative credentials are declared as secure parameters, never embedded.
costConsiderations: VM size is the dominant cost driver; prefer a small general-purpose or burstable size for labs.
A public IPv4 address, if requested, incurs an hourly charge.
The managed OS disk incurs storage cost for the lab duration.
limitations: Region and size availability cannot be confirmed by this tool.
Windows and Linux require different image references and osProfile settings.

evidence.sourceTitle: Azure VM quickstart templates (ARM template reference)
evidence.rationale: The single-VM composition follows the documented virtualMachines + networkInterface + virtualNetwork relationship.
